notes: Draft for slice 1 acceptance. Carries the Phase 1 gate fixes. The updates theme is redesigned to regression only phrasing after failing the precision gate at about two in five. The ease theme is renamed interface and design after its genuine citations proved to be design remarks. Proven polysemy triggers are removed, namely responsive for developer responsiveness, saves for saves time, and tracking for bug tracking. Inflected forms are listed explicitly because matching is whole token. Audit round of 2026-11-21, scored on the Phase 1 corpus under the audit design. Crashes and stability, praise, and interface and design each scored ten in ten. Missing features scored eight in ten, at the gate, and its two failing phrases wish it and no way to are removed. Battery failed at two in ten because the bare battery phrase measures the app domain in a corpus full of battery widgets, so the theme is redesigned to drain and consumption phrasing. Performance failed at three in nine because speed words measured charger speed, so bare slow, fast, and speed are removed. Privacy failed at four in six because bare permission caught folder permissions and settings requests, so the theme is redesigned to concern phrasing. Ads scored three in four and stands unmeasured under the five citation rule. The redesigned themes are remeasured before this file ships, and any theme still failing is pulled. Remeasurement results. Battery passes at five in five once bare drain is also removed, because in this corpus drain mostly names the measurement the widgets display. Missing features passes at ten in ten on its new sample. Performance falls under minimum support on this corpus and is suppressed in output, asserting nothing. Privacy and ads are pulled from this taxonomy under the audit contract. Both were counted themes whose pools, at four citations each, sit under the five citation measurement floor, so neither may ship as a counted theme on lexicon strength alone. Their samples were scored anyway. Privacy scored four in four genuine and ads three in four with one unclear. Both return to the default taxonomy when any corpus gives them five citations to measure. Sync and regressions after update also sit under minimum support on this corpus and are listed as suppressed, not counted. This file ships only after the audit sample is scored per theme at four in five or better, with any failing theme pulled or redesigned.
